findings.message: The new download is a distinct 1024x1536 PNG with SHA-256 056d0292a7fc8bd67f4381b4a535cd0a47201cef981283ad26ab701a9bd85ec2 and contains Maribel Santos only.

The v001 body-design blocker is resolved. The full-body studies now show a broader torso, waist, hips, arms, and legs, producing the required sturdy, practical 44-year-old working silhouette without changing Maribel's established face.
The v001 finish blocker is resolved. All head-study shoulders and lower bust edges terminate with crisp ink contours and flat-tone boundaries on white paper, with no feathered vignette dissolves.

Layout, identity, and wardrobe continuity pass. The sheet preserves exactly six studies, short silver-black hair with close sides, cat-eye glasses and chain, a dry observant adult presence, linen blazer, plain blouse, practical trousers, archive-work hands, readable feet, and ink staining on the anatomical left cuff.

The reference finish is consistent with the accepted lead sheets: controlled black hair masses, restrained flat tone, sparse hatching, matte clothing, white paper, and no environment, plot prop, readable text, logo, signature, watermark, cinematic lighting, or glossy rendering.

Visual approval is recommended, but Maribel's brief remains storyboard-conditional and no approved storyboard currently confirms that she is visible. Promotion must remain blocked until that condition is satisfied and the user gives explicit approval.

The exact executed image job was not supplied and the Downloads filename omits the planned version suffix. Future promotion must preserve the exact bytes under maribel-santos-reference-v002.png and bind that file by SHA-256.
No image was edited, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted. The Downloads original remains unchanged and a byte-identical copy is retained only as internal review evidence.
